# logs

:::info[Typed specification]

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`adapters/kubernetes/spec/ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/kubernetes/spec/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

:::

Kubernetes-owned pod log selection, line observations and truncation accounting of pods.logs.

`connectors_kubernetes.logs` is one of connectors_kubernetes's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `LogLine`

`connectors_kubernetes.logs.LogLine` is a record of five fields:

- `timestamp_unix_ns` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `stream` — `connectors_kubernetes.logs.LogStream`
- `line` — `String`
- `line_truncated` — `Boolean`
- `redacted` — `Boolean`

Every value satisfies `line.count <= 8192`.

### `LogStream`

`connectors_kubernetes.logs.LogStream` is a record of three fields:

- `namespace` — `String`
- `pod` — `String`
- `container` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent

### `LogTruncation`

`connectors_kubernetes.logs.LogTruncation` is a record of three fields:

- `causes` — `List<connectors_kubernetes.logs.TruncationCause>`
- `occurrences_dropped` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent
- `stream_groups_dropped` — `Integer`

Every value satisfies `causes.count <= 3` and `(stream_groups_dropped >= 0 and stream_groups_dropped <= 0)`.

### `PodLogSelection`

`connectors_kubernetes.logs.PodLogSelection` is a record of six fields:

- `namespace` — `String`
- `pod` — `String`
- `container` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `since_seconds` — `Integer`
- `tail_lines` — `Integer`
- `max_bytes` — `Integer`

Every value satisfies `(namespace.count >= 1 and namespace.count <= 63)`, `(pod.count >= 1 and pod.count <= 253)`, `(not (defined(container)) or (container.count >= 1 and container.count <= 63))`, `(since_seconds >= 1 and since_seconds <= 86400)`, `(tail_lines >= 1 and tail_lines <= 1000)` and `(max_bytes >= 1 and max_bytes <= 131072)`.

### `PodLogs`

`connectors_kubernetes.logs.PodLogs` is a record of five fields:

- `lines` — `List<connectors_kubernetes.logs.LogLine>`
- `since_seconds` — `Integer`
- `tail_lines` — `Integer`
- `complete` — `Boolean`
- `truncation` — `connectors_kubernetes.logs.LogTruncation`

Every value satisfies `lines.count <= 1000`.

### `TruncationCause`

`connectors_kubernetes.logs.TruncationCause` is one of `provider_limit`, `source_bytes` and `line_bytes`.

Two of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors_kubernetes.logs.PodLogSelection` and `connectors_kubernetes.logs.PodLogs`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
